skills.name: deep-refactor
skills.description: Audit an entire codebase for defects, waste and debt, then ticket and ship the findings as a sequenced PR train — without breaking the test contract. Triggers: deep refactor, refactor audit, clean the codebase, DRY pass, audit and fix everything.
headings: Work discovered mid-phase — do it, or ticket it properly
skills.description_zh: 审计整个代码库的缺陷、浪费与技术债，将发现转成工单并通过有序PR逐项交付，保持测试契约。

skills.name: doc-refactor
skills.description: Audit every markdown file in a repo — READMEs, docs/, and agent-instruction files — for lies, drift, duplication and bloat, then ticket and ship the cleanup as a sequenced PR train, with source code frozen and every surviving claim verified against the repo rather than read. Triggers: doc refactor, refactor the docs, clean the docs, documentation audit, README audit, docs are stale, DRY the docs, audit every markdown file.
headings: Work discovered mid-phase — do it, or ticket it properly
skills.description_zh: 审计仓库全部Markdown的错误声明、漂移、重复与冗余，冻结源码并核对保留声明与仓库一致，通过工单和有序PR交付文档清理。

skills.name: test-refactor
skills.description: Audit one test suite at a time for dead weight, duplication, parallel-unsafety and runtime cost, then ticket and ship the cleanup as a PR train — with production code frozen and good coverage kept, proven per module rather than assumed. Triggers: test refactor, clean the tests, refactor the tests, test suite audit, DRY the tests, parallelize the test suite, speed up the tests.
headings: Work discovered mid-phase — do it, or ticket it properly
skills.description_zh: 逐套审计测试的无效内容、重复、并行不安全及运行成本，冻结生产代码、逐模块证明保留覆盖，并通过工单和有序PR清理。
